name: good_boy
revision: vNext r-cast (2026-11-10): script_vNext.md's r-cast table: Buh speaks L11 and L13 in his own voice; one spoken stress per sentence (the CAPS word in `say`)
caption: my human tried to lose me 37 times 🐺
logline: A dog tells how its human tried to lose it thirty-seven times, and why he never once made it sit.
question: why tf would he try to lose his own dog?
premise: The narrator is Buh's tamed wolf, said openly from line 1. Buh (16, never named aloud) has tried to lose it 37 times: tamed wolves teleport back to their owner from 12 blocks, unless they're sitting, and a sitting dog waits forever. He wants it to forget him, so he never makes it sit. He keeps talking about college; every night he says sorry.
twist: He was leaving the game for good and wanted the dog free, not waiting. On the last morning he walks it up Dog Hill to his old hut, says 'sit, boy' and 'I'll be right back', and the chat says 'Buh left the game': the one sit he avoided 37 times is the one he finally used. The first frame of Dog on the Hill.

N.name: me (the dog)
N.on_screen: Buh's tamed wolf, red collar: the POV at a wolf's eye height; in camera shots the wolf at his side

Buh.on_screen: actor bot Buh, Steve skin; speaks only L11 and L13

lines.text: My HUMAN / has TRIED / to LOSE me / thirty-seven TIMES.
lines.say: My human has tried to lose me thirty-seven TIMES.

lines.text: He RUNS. / I FOLLOW. / Twelve BLOCKS out, / I POP up / right NEXT to him.
lines.say: He runs. I follow. Twelve blocks out, I pop up right NEXT to him.

lines.text: He tried the WHEAT. / The HILLS. / An ISLAND.
lines.say: He tried the WHEAT. The HILLS. An ISLAND.

lines.text: But SITTING? / I STAY put. / He NEVER / makes me SIT.
lines.say: But SITTING? I stay put. He never makes me SIT.

lines.text: He SAYS / a WAITING dog / is a SAD dog. / He WANTS me / to FORGET him.
lines.say: He says a waiting dog is a SAD dog. He wants me to FORGET him.

lines.text: He keeps TALKING / about COLLEGE. / Far AWAY.
lines.say: He keeps talking about COLLEGE. Far AWAY.

lines.text: Every NIGHT / he SAYS, / sorry, BUDDY. / I don't KNOW / what FOR.
lines.say: Every night he says, SORRY, buddy. I don't know what FOR.

lines.text: This MORNING / he WALKED me / HOME, / up the HILL.
lines.say: This morning he walked me home, up the HILL.

lines.direction: choked and quick: a teenager holding it together, brisk, NOT soft or breathy, not a command to a pet

lines.text: So I SAT. / SITTING dogs / wait FOREVER.
lines.say: So I SAT. Sitting dogs wait FOREVER.
